bullets.title: Fractional Olympic Plates
bullets.note:
These little bad boys, weightlifting plates of ¼ pound and up, are useful for
ego boosting (“I just hit a new PR [personal record]!”). More important, I can
use them for fixing physical issues related to tiny muscles or sensitive
tendons. Specifically, I’m using them in [eccentric (lowering) exercises for
fixing my “golfer’s
elbow”](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wAJ&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=I&)
caused from rock climbing. Thanks to you all for pointing me to that article!
I’ve tested it, and it works.
